shots.visual: A man stands at the bow of a warship, looking ahead with a greedy smile.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 陳留，注定要落入我手中！

shots.visual: A massive fleet of Eastern Wu warships sails through a narrow river passage.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 趁著魏蜀大戰，孫權傾巢而出。

shots.visual: A man in royal robes slams his fist onto a table, his face twisted in rage.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 孫權這鼠輩，竟敢背後捅刀！

shots.visual: He stands up, pointing his finger toward the south, shaking with anger.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 我要讓他有來無回！

shots.visual: A strategist holding a feather fan stands to the left of a calm man sitting by a map.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，孫權的水師已入腹地。

shots.visual: A man stares at the map, a subtle, knowing smile on his lips.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 他若不來，我這戲可演不下去。

shots.visual: The strategist looks surprised, his fan stopping mid-air.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 您是故意放慢行軍速度？

shots.visual: The man stands up and moves a piece on the map representing the Wu army.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 不給他點甜頭，他怎肯入局？

shots.visual: The commander of Wu stands on the deck, looking at the distant city through a spyglass.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備已被曹丕牽制，根本無暇他顧！

shots.visual: He laughs loudly, his eyes filled with ambition.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 天下，終究是我的！

shots.visual: A commander leads a small troop away from the main front, retreating toward the woods.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 劉備軍隊假裝潰散，引誘吳軍深入。

shots.visual: A soldier runs to the commander and whispers; the commander looks excited.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備逃了？全軍登陸追擊！

shots.visual: The commander steps onto the shore, looking at the abandoned camp items.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 皇叔？也不過如此！

shots.visual: From the high cliff, a man looks down at the Wu army flooding the valley.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 看，魚兒上鉤了。

shots.visual: The strategist stands next to him, holding a signal torch.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 火攻之計，隨時可以發動。

shots.visual: The man's eyes reflect the distant sunlight, cold and sharp.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 再等等，讓他們全部進來。

shots.visual: The Wu commander stands in the middle of the narrow valley, feeling a strange wind.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 為何此處如此安靜？

shots.visual: The man on the horse turns around, his cape fluttering in the wind.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權，你來得正好。

shots.visual: He points his sword toward the valley where the Wu army is trapped.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 正好當我一統天下的燃料。

shots.visual: The commander looks up at the cliff, his pupils contracting in terror.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 中計了！撤退！快撤退！

shots.visual: The man's cold face fills the screen as he drops a burning torch.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 晚了，燒！
